items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know. ‘Cause they only had one Josephine Baker. I guess Paris thought that was enough.

ctx.x: Yes. Can I ask you, do you think that if you had gone to Paris when you were a young person that you would have fared better in your career in the United States?
I don’t know. ‘Cause they only had one Josephine Baker. I guess Paris thought that was enough.
Have you ever played there, Paris?
